capabilityLimits: Each SP branch compares the complete autonomous original-to-terminal decision trace and full native world with real codec replay, then starts a same-realm second match.

Host-transfer branch adds an independent real two-client reconnect/checkpoint/promotion and old-command/receipt fence, then continues that promoted match to its actual result and same-realm second match. Multiplayer has no save/load.
Actual terminal win/loss/tie, useful delivered income, production and native combat are mandatory; this lifecycle case does not replace the separate both-faction victory gate.
